technical.summary: CMI shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku cloud) but lacks short-term confirmation; oversold conditions with rising RSI suggest potential bounce, but weak ADX, negative MACD, and price below key moving averages indicate insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: CMI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 52 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; market in fear zone (38/100) with bearish sentiment (44.6%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (240+), FOMC just concluded; earnings in 52 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly adverse for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with oversold RSI rising and fear-zone sentiment creates potential contrarian bounce opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC uncertainty), fundamentals show zero conviction (no insider/institutional buying, high earnings risk in 52 days), and short-term technicals lack confluence (weak ADX, negative MACD, price below key MAs)—insufficient edge to justify entry.

decision.entry_rationale: CMI shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku) and oversold RSI rising in fear-zone sentiment, creating a potential contrarian bounce setup. However, macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), fundamentals lack conviction (zero smart money, high earnings risk in 52 days), and short-term technicals show weak confluence (negative MACD, weak ADX, price below key MAs)—insufficient edge to justify entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis signal recession risk; earnings in 52 days create binary event risk that could gap through support regardless of technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; bear case dominates with high confidence
decision.portfolio_note: Already 37 positions in Industrials (15% of portfolio); sector concentration is elevated and argues against adding CMI exposure.
